bridgeCurrentPlanning.basis: Accepted provisional design loads are 1 A VCCL, 3 A VDD and 0.10 A combined VCCH/VCCA33. ASMedia's PDX reference supply sizing informs VCCL and VDD. The 3.3 V allowance is a project assumption. None is a verified PDX current maximum.
bridgeCurrentPlanning.referenceSchematic: datasheets/ASM2464PDX_TI_R03.pdf sheet 4; supply ratings, not measured chip currents
bridgeCurrentPlanning.pdReferenceStatus: Historical comparison; superseded as the active design-load basis
bridgeCurrentPlanning.referenceDocument: ASMedia ASM2464PD datasheet revision 0.4, May 5, 2023, sections 6.2 and 6.3.12, pages 15 and 18
bridgeCurrentPlanning.limitations: The PDX uses a nominal 1.13 V core supply. The PD table and PDX reference supply ratings do not establish actual load or transients. The combined 100 mA allowance has no verified VCCH/VCCA33 split. Other 3.3 V loads require separate budgets. The VDD budget uses the full 3 A nominal regulator rating. Startup, ripple, load response and temperatures require hardware checks. The separate 3 A conductor screen on both rails and its 8 mV limit remain unchanged. Earlier reports do not validate the accepted budgets.

localContactNote: Short BGA and capacitor contacts use fine geometry where the pad pitch prevents a 15 mil track. Broad regions carry the main rail current. The emitted-copper DC screen checks these contacts as part of each supply path. The 0.5 oz revision uses 0.155 mm inner via-land antipads; the separate drill-to-plane checks still enforce 0.20 mm for vias and 0.30 mm for plated component holes. The BGA top fill uses 0.15 mm trace/pad clearance and 0.20 mm inter-pour clearance. Main region clearance remains 0.205 mm.

projectDcScreen.scope: Actual top and bottom copper, both assigned inner power regions, and plated via barrels.

qualification.note: The 2026-10-27 0.5 oz layout review records 7.839 mV on VDD at its 3 A planning load and 5.727 mV on VCCL at its 1 A planning load, including the unchanged mesh allowance. Both meet the 8 mV project limit. The retained VCCL 3 A stress screen is 17.180 mV and remains open. Actual-load voltage qualification remains open. Package losses, ground return, capacitor impedance, unequal ball currents, ripple and load steps require separate qualification.
